stemMarkdown: The price of rice rises by 20%. By what percent must a family reduce its consumption so that its total expenditure on rice only rises by 10%? (Round to 2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Take price $= 100$ and consumption $= 100$, so expenditure $= 10000$. The new price is $120$ and the new expenditure must be $11000$, so the new consumption is $\dfrac{11000}{120} = 91.67$. That is a drop of $8.33\%$.
